rationale: Elias is a consumer-AI founder shipping products with deep ML/infra convictions around open-source vector databases and developer tooling, while Abdul is a student researcher actively working in ML research and LLM tooling—creating a natural mentor-collaborator dynamic. Both are in San Francisco, share Python in their stack, and overlap on LLM tooling; Elias's experience scaling consumer AI products at Lee-AI and conviction about moving fast in the current technological moment could directly inform Abdul's research direction.
intro_message: Elias Schwalme, meet Abdul Basith — Abdul's doing ML research and LLM tooling work at Northeastern, and your experience shipping consumer AI products and building ML infrastructure could be valuable perspective as he develops his research.
